info.description: Postman collection for the HRMS & Payroll backend. Grouped by feature module. First, run **Auth → Login** — its test script auto-saves `accessToken` + `refreshToken` to the collection variables; every other request then uses them via the collection-level Bearer auth.

exec: console.log('Saved accessToken + refreshToken to collection variables.');
